units.text: INT. TAXIDERMY WORKSHOP - EVENING
Glass eyes on every shelf.
A stuffed heron guards the doorway.
Under a green-shaded lamp, a long worktable holds a half-mounted fox and a ledger.
INSPECTOR AUGUSTINE BELLAMY-OKAFOR (50s, bowler hat, wet umbrella) stands at the table.
Opposite him, MISS CLEMENTINE VASQUEZ-HOLT (40s, leather apron, a scalpel in her fist) hovers over the fox.

Seated on a stool by the stove are two others: the widow MRS. ODALYS PRENDERGAST (60s, black gloves, a handbag clutched in her lap) and the young apprentice WILFRED TANAKA (19, soot on his cuffs, eyes on the floor).
Mrs. Prendergast, your husband died on the fourteenth.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: He did.
units.name: MRS. PRENDERGAST

units.text: And on the fifteenth you commissioned a mounting.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: A cat.
units.name: MRS. PRENDERGAST

units.text: A cat. Which weighs, according to this ledger, eleven stone.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: We had to reinforce the frame.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: Did you.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: It's a very large cat.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: Mr. Tanaka. You did the packing.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: I did, sir.
units.name: WILFRED

units.text: What was inside the cat?
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: Sawdust, sir.
units.name: WILFRED

units.text: Only sawdust?
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: And a few cotton wads. Sir.
units.name: WILFRED

units.text: And the eleven stone?
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: I only lifted the end, sir.
units.name: WILFRED

units.text: Wilfred is a good boy.
units.name: MRS. PRENDERGAST

units.text: I'm sure he is. Miss Vasquez. You are an artist.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: I am a craftswoman.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: You can tell, I think, the difference between a cat and a man.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: I can tell the difference between a cat and a lie.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: Which was this?
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: A cat.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: Then open it.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: Silence.
The stove ticks.
Mrs. Prendergast tightens her grip on her handbag.
Wilfred stares at the floorboards.
It's been sewn shut.
units.name: MISS VASQUEZ

units.text: Cut the stitches.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: Inspector, please. He was a very private man.
units.name: MRS. PRENDERGAST

units.text: He is a very dead one, madam.
units.name: BELLAMY

units.text: The scalpel catches the lamplight.
Bellamy steps forward, and the others half-rise as one.
Miss Vasquez raises the blade, Wilfred bolts for the door, and Mrs. Prendergast lunges for the handbag as it slides from her lap.
The stuffed heron topples across the doorway.
Wilfred trips over it and falls flat.
